answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops Sybil farms. Each identity locks 40 tokens and names a sponsor; ones sharing a funder show as a star. A prism audit splits funding trails into strands; one duplicate link freezes the cluster. A fake sends a ripple, and a proven duplicate slashes its deposit and the sponsor bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 tokens; one honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its rewards. Newcomers dock at a sponsor jetty.
